name: mcp-rubric
description: Rubric CLI — Postman + ESLint for MCP servers. Runs the web UI and CI scans that score MCP protocol conformance, quality, and security.
author: Salahuddin Uqaili

scripts.build: pnpm --filter mcp-rubric-shared --filter mcp-rubric-server --filter mcp-rubric-client build && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../client/dist','dist/client',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('../../README.md','README.md')"
